fields.description: Prefix used to auto-generate the return document number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The field service job that triggered this equipment return.
fields.label: Service Job

fields.description: The installed equipment unit being pulled from site for return or workshop repair.
fields.label: Installed Equipment

fields.description: The customer who owns the returned equipment, fetched from the service job.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: Current stage of the return workflow, from pickup through workshop repair to dispatch.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Pickup Requested
Picked Up
Workshop Received
Initial Inspection
Estimate Required
Awaiting Customer Approval
Repair In Progress
Waiting Material
Repair Completed
Testing
Quality Inspection
Ready for Dispatch
Dispatched
Reinstalled
Closed
Cancelled

fields.description: Date the equipment was logged as returned.
fields.label: Return Date

fields.description: Warehouse where restocked or refurbished parts are received back into stock.
fields.label: Receiving Warehouse

fields.description: Date and time the equipment was collected from the customer site.
fields.label: Pickup Date

fields.description: Address from which the equipment is to be picked up.
fields.label: Pickup Address

fields.description: Line items listing each part or unit included in this return.
fields.label: Items

fields.description: The stock entry posted to record the returned items back into inventory.
fields.label: Stock Entry

fields.description: ERPNext quotation raised for chargeable repair or replacement work.
fields.label: ERPNext Quotation

fields.description: ERPNext sales invoice billing the customer for the repair.
fields.label: ERPNext Sales Invoice

fields.description: Reason the equipment is being returned, such as fault, warranty, or replacement.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Whether the customer has approved the repair estimate before work proceeds.
fields.label: Customer Approval

fields.description: Timestamp when the customer approved or rejected the repair estimate.
fields.label: Customer Approval On

fields.description: Workshop notes describing the diagnosis and repair actions taken.
fields.label: Repair Notes

fields.description: Results of functional testing performed after the repair.
fields.label: Testing Result

fields.description: Outcome of the final quality inspection, pass or fail.
fields.label: Quality Result

fields.description: Final disposition of the equipment, such as repaired, replaced, or not repairable.
fields.label: Final Outcome
fields.options:
Repaired
Not Repairable
Replacement Recommended
Replaced

fields.description: General remarks about the return not captured in other fields.
fields.label: Notes
